[
    {"bbox_2d": [87, 69, 481, 103], "text": "Farg'onada Lacetti velosipedchini urib yubordi. Jabrlanuvchi"},
    {"bbox_2d": [85, 115, 226, 150], "text": "shifoxonada vafot etdi"},
    {"bbox_2d": [99, 172, 415, 206], "text": "Farg'ona viloyatining Dang'ara tumanida"},
    {"bbox_2d": [90, 220, 430, 254], "text": "Lacetti va velosiped ishtirokida yo'l-transport hodisasi"},
    {"bbox_2d": [90, 275, 562, 310], "text": "sodir boldi. Bu haqda \"Daryo\"ga viloyat JIB axborot xizmati"},
    {"bbox_2d": [90, 323, 516, 358], "text": "Ma'lum qilinishicha, 2021-yilning 8-aprel kuni fuqaro N.Yo."},
    {"bbox_2d": [85, 379, 321, 413], "text": "boshqaruvidagi Lacetti Toshkent"},
    {"bbox_2d": [87, 436, 443, 470], "text": "ko'chasida ketayotib, yo'lning qatnov qismini"},
    {"bbox_2d": [87, 491, 442, 525], "text": "velosipedda kesib o'tayotgan A.B.ni urib yuborgan."},
    {"bbox_2d": [95, 540, 468, 574], "text": "Oqibatda A.B. tan jarohati olib, shifoxonada vafot"},
    {"bbox_2d": [90, 590, 464, 624], "text": "Holat yuzasidan Dang'ara tuman JIB huzuridagi tergov"},
    {"bbox_2d": [90, 640, 325, 674], "text": "bo'linmasi tomonidan Jinoyat"},
    {"bbox_2d": [87, 695, 455, 730], "text": "kodeksining 266-moddasi 2-qismi (transport"},
    {"bbox_2d": [85, 745, 446, 779], "text": "vositalari harakati yoki ulardan foydalanish xarfsizligi"},
    {"bbox_2d": [87, 795, 467, 830], "text": "qoidalarini buzish) bilan jinoyat ishi qo'zg'atilgan."},
    {"bbox_2d": [87, 845, 314, 880], "text": "Ayni paytda tergov harakatlari"}
]

[
    {"bbox_2d": [109, 73, 534, 106], "text": "Eslatib o'tamiz, avvalroq Yakkasaroyda Lacetti, Damas"},
    {"bbox_2d": [105, 120, 613, 158], "text": "hamda Spark ishtirokida YTH sodir bo'lgani, Jizzaxda esa yuk"},
    {"bbox_2d": [105, 170, 567, 206], "text": "mashinasi va 2 avtomobil ishtirokidagi YTH oqibatda 1"},
    {"bbox_2d": [102, 220, 446, 257], "text": "kishi vajot etgani haqida xabar berilgandi."},
    {"bbox_2d": [102, 272, 417, 307], "text": "Tushkunlik va kuzgi mayuslikni qanday qilib"},
    {"bbox_2d": [109, 325, 265, 360], "text": "yengib o'tish mumkin?"},
    {"bbox_2d": [102, 380, 353, 416], "text": "O'zbekistonda kuz yetarlicha issiq"},
    {"bbox_2d": [102, 432, 391, 468], "text": "kelganiga qaramay, kuzgi zerikish"},
    {"bbox_2d": [99, 484, 543, 520], "text": "ko'pchiligimiz uchun tanish holat. Yoz va ta'tillar"},
    {"bbox_2d": [102, 537, 280, 573], "text": "ortda qoldi, yangi yil"},
    {"bbox_2d": [112, 590, 496, 626], "text": "tantanalarigacha esa hali yetarlicha muddat"},
    {"bbox_2d": [97, 643, 326, 679], "text": "bor. Kunlar qisqarib, ishdan"},
    {"bbox_2d": [112, 696, 524, 732], "text": "qaytishingiz bilan qorong'i tushadi. Quyoshli kunlar"},
    {"bbox_2d": [100, 749, 353, 785], "text": "kamayib boraverhani sayin zerikish"},
    {"bbox_2d": [99, 801, 508, 837], "text": "Xo'sh, bunday sharoitda zerikish va tushkunlikka qarshi"},
    {"bbox_2d": [102, 854, 498, 890], "text": "kurashish uchun qaysi usullarni qo'llay olamiz?"}
]

[
    {"bbox_2d": [103, 65, 454, 98], "text": "Birinchi navbatda, uyqu rejimingizni qayta ko'rib"},
    {"bbox_2d": [97, 120, 517, 157], "text": "chiqing. Bu davrda o'z vaqtida uyquga yotib, vaqtida"},
    {"bbox_2d": [93, 175, 376, 208], "text": "uyg'onish juda muhim! 23:00 dan kech"},
    {"bbox_2d": [103, 229, 494, 266], "text": "bo'lmasdan uyquga yotishga harakat qiling."},
    {"bbox_2d": [99, 279, 710, 318], "text": "Shunda sifatli uyqu nima ekanligini anglab yetasiz, kayfiyatingiz"},
    {"bbox_2d": [102, 333, 282, 366], "text": "Ikkinchi muhim jihat —"},
    {"bbox_2d": [103, 385, 345, 418], "text": "ovqatlanish. Ko'proq meva va"},
    {"bbox_2d": [92, 439, 263, 472], "text": "sabzavotlar iste'mol qilib,"},
    {"bbox_2d": [103, 492, 442, 525], "text": "hazm qilish uchun ko'p vaqt talab qiluvchi yog'li"},
    {"bbox_2d": [103, 544, 363, 577], "text": "taomlarni kamroq tanovul qiling."},
    {"bbox_2d": [95, 596, 314, 629], "text": "Shirinliklarni ham minimal"},
    {"bbox_2d": [99, 649, 333, 682], "text": "darajagacha kamaytirishni tavsiya"},
    {"bbox_2d": [94, 699, 309, 732], "text": "etamiz. U tushkunlikka qarshi"},
    {"bbox_2d": [97, 752, 473, 785], "text": "kurashishda yordam bersa ham, kichikroq bo'lakchalar"},
    {"bbox_2d": [95, 804, 287, 837], "text": "(shokolad bo'lakchasi yoki"},
    {"bbox_2d": [100, 857, 253, 890], "text": "bitta bulochka) bilan"}
]
